prospective_candidate.target: Narrow conditional omission of truly unconsumed sine for sourcePerformance thermal drift, plus separately qualified signed-zero drift path in PURE isolation/Legacy without changing audible pitch or FP side effects.
prospective_candidate.isolation_caveat: The hard baseline suite sets parityMode=1 and Engine::buildSettings forces effective global.drift=+0.0f. A thermal-only optimization cannot reduce the hard isolation held CPU at all. A naive drift==0 shortcut has been deliberately killed by the frozen signed-zero test.
prospective_candidate.required_same_state: All audible samples, filter/oscillator states, pitch CV/readouts, voice/allocator state, source Q/LC ports, output capacitor/tail states, and saved/captured Legacy/V1/V2 bytes remain bit-exact. No re-pin, altered tolerance, new drift law or source-model switch.
prospective_candidate.fp_rules: Preserve IEEE driftVoice sign of zero when its bit pattern is observed by a consumer and preserve resultant driftTerm/pitch behavior. Preserve caller FE sticky exception bits, rounding mode and supported MXCSR FTZ/DAZ control bits. Do not silently discard sinf's inexact exception, introduce unguarded FE_INVALID/UNDERFLOW, force a global FP mode or substitute rounded trig approximations. Unsupported modes must run exact original scalar expression.
prospective_candidate.scope_and_avoidance: No destructive idle skip, no omitted touch/bus/wake/chorus/EG clocks, no performance rendering-mode switch, no reordering rank iteration, no fast-math or floating contraction change.
